item.title: Virtual Webinar Addresses Treatable Memory Loss Causes
item.description:
Virtual Webinar Addresses Treatable Memory Loss Causes

On October 14, 2026, a virtual webinar titled “Worried About Your Memory? – It May Not Be Dementia –” was held to educate participants on treatable conditions that can cause memory loss and how to differentiate dementia from normal age‑related lapses.

🔍 Overview

  • Learn what treatable conditions can cause memory loss and how to distinguish dementia from normal age‑related memory lapses.
  • Emphasis on recognizing that memory issues are not always dementia.

📊 Key Facts

  • Almost 40 % of people will experience some form of memory loss after the age of 65.
  • The event was co‑sponsored by AARP.
  • Duration: 1 hour.

💻 Logistics

  • Format: Virtual event via Zoom.
  • Date: 10/14/2026.
  • Organized by: (organizer not specified in evidence).
  • Location note: Amazing Place, 3735 Drexel Drive, Houston, TX 77027 (listed despite virtual format).

🎯 Who Should Attend

  • Individuals concerned about declining memory and thinking abilities.
  • Caregivers and families looking for information on distinguishing normal aging from dementia.

#memory #dementia #health #webinar #AARP

Source: Worried About Your Memory? -It May Not Be Dementia- WEBINAR 10/14/2026

item.title: Health, Environment, and Politics Clash Over New U.S. AI Data Centers
item.description:
Health, Environment, and Politics Clash Over New U.S. AI Data Centers

New, large‑scale AI data centers are being built across U.S. neighborhoods, sparking a heated debate about health, environment, and politics.

📊 Overview

  • “Many U.S. residents say their health problems are being caused by new data centers being built in their neighborhoods.”
  • “President Trump only sees the potential economic benefits of these large‑scale projects.”
  • “Not all elected officials agree with him, including Democratic House Representative Alexandria Ocasio‑Cortez, who is sounding the alarm on the environmental impact — and she’s not the only one.”
  • “This debate is having a significant effect on the upcoming U.S. midterm elections, deepening the divide between supporters and opponents.”
  • “There is no doubt that the AI boom will change the U.S., but at what cost?”
